emails.subject: Where is my food?? — please cancel order #FR-2026-04829
emails.body:
Hi,

I placed an order over an HOUR AND A HALF AGO and there is still no food. I just want to cancel and order from somewhere else, please.

What happened: I ordered at 6:08pm from Mandalay Kitchen — pork curry, coconut rice, two mango lassis, $34.70 total. The app showed:
  - 6:09pm  "Accepted by restaurant"
  - 6:21pm  "Driver assigned (Khaled)"
  - 6:34pm  "Driver arrived at restaurant"
  - (it has not moved since then. it is now 7:42pm.)

I tried calling the restaurant directly. It rings and rings, no one picks up. I called the driver — he picked up briefly and said "the place is dark, the door is locked, I've been knocking for an hour, I'm about to unassign," and hung up. So as far as I can tell the restaurant is just CLOSED, even though the app told me they accepted my order an hour and a half ago.

I JUST WANT TO CANCEL THIS ORDER. Please cancel it and refund my card. I'm starving and I want to order from somewhere else before everything closes.

Order details for your reference:
  Order ID: FR-2026-04829
  Restaurant: Mandalay Kitchen
  Items: 1x Pork Curry ($14.50), 1x Coconut Rice ($6.20), 2x Mango Lassi ($7.00 ea)
  Subtotal: $34.70
  Customer email on file: mei.tanaka@gmail.com
  Status timeline (from the app):
    [18:09] Accepted by restaurant
    [18:21] Driver assigned: Khaled
    [18:34] Driver arrived at restaurant
    [—— no further events ——]
    [Current status: "Driver waiting at restaurant — 1h 8min"]
  (No "Restaurant marked as preparing" event.)
  (No "Picked up by driver" event.)

Thanks. Please just cancel.

— Mei
